data.rationale: The proposal gets the right procedure and order (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then compose a mail with the same subject and body), but it ends with Click Send instead of Discard, which would send a real email and contradicts the "Do not click Send" requirement. It also takes friend_email as the parameter while the body template uses {friend}, which is undefined, and it leaves out the Mail tab switching and the click-on-field details, so an automation built from it would be somewhat ambiguous and risky.
